mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the membranes to the cochleas was most worthwhile: the result explained how fluid movement bends hair-cell bundles and changes nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished ears to their pathways and then to the body felt somewhat repetitive, though both connections served the goal.

surprise.text: The hair cells had to be added to the cochlear chambers before the membranes; the initial descriptions did not make that order clear.

arbitrary.text: That required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary because the hair cells and membranes were described together.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored a different process. Following vibrations into nerve signals was interesting, although the final connections offered fewer meaningful choices.
